critical_code_review_comments: markdownToHtmlLite shifts heading levels: `## Welcome` renders as <h3> and `### Why us` as <h4> in city bodyContent. This produces <h1> (page title) → <h3> (first section) with no <h2> in between, which is a minor SEO/accessibility heading-hierarchy skip. Not a blocker (the standalone 'Nearby areas we cover' and 'Popular tile collections' <h2>s do exist), but consider normalising markdown ## to <h2> for well-formed hierarchy.

buildCityPageMeta breadcrumb uses row.town || row.display_name || slug — in the fake-row test, when neither field is present the breadcrumb renders `` (empty label). Not a live-data issue if the DB row always populates town/display_name, but worth defaulting to a humanised slug for safety.

enrichSeo now does an extra DB/API call (lookupCityPage) on every /tiles/:slug and /products/:slug request before falling back to lookupProduct — small latency cost for every product PDP hit. Caching lookupCityPage misses would eliminate this.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The Node SSR files (/app/frontend/server-seo.js and /app/frontend/server-seo-enrich.js) are Railway-production-only and are NOT served by the preview's craco dev server. Do not curl the preview URL expecting to see SSR bodyContent — it will not be there. Verification must be via direct `node` require of the exported functions. /app/frontend/test_seo_enrich_node.js provides a reusable regression harness (20 assertions, exit 0 on pass). The /api/seo/overrides endpoint has noindex_count=0 which is the healthy expected state (the safelist + PDP purge from iter249 keeps the collection clean).
